t: Signature Qiskit: What Qiskit Is: Programming Quantum Computers
title: Signature Qiskit: What Qiskit Is: Programming Quantum Computers
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigQubit bench, Manon's original quantum-programming design. It mirrors the circuit-transpile-simulate-execute pipeline but every circuit carries a resource manifest — qubit count, depth, gate counts — computed before execution. The Signature design refuses to queue circuits whose manifest exceeds the target's published capacity.

description: The bench's transpiler is the tailor: same mapping and decomposition, but it reports the fit quality — depth inflation factor, SWAP count — as a grade.
